achievements.name: Enkindle
achievements.detail: Rest at a bonfire for the first time so its flame stays lit.

achievements.name: Estus Flask
achievements.detail: Receive the Estus Flask and fill it at a bonfire.

achievements.name: Reach Lordran
achievements.detail: Leave the Undead Asylum with the crow and arrive in Lordran.

achievements.name: Upper Bell
achievements.detail: Ring the Bell of Awakening in the Undead Church.

achievements.name: Lower Bell
achievements.detail: Ring the Bell of Awakening in Quelaag's Domain.

achievements.name: Abysswalking
achievements.detail: Defeat Great Grey Wolf Sif and take the ring that opens the Abyss.

achievements.name: Anor Londo
achievements.detail: Pass through Sen's Fortress and arrive in Anor Londo.

achievements.name: Lordvessel
achievements.detail: Defeat Ornstein and Smough, then claim the Lordvessel.

achievements.name: Gravelord Nito
achievements.detail: Defeat Gravelord Nito in the Tomb of the Giants.

achievements.name: Bed of Chaos
achievements.detail: Defeat the Bed of Chaos in Lost Izalith.

achievements.name: Four Kings
achievements.detail: Defeat the Four Kings in the Abyss beneath New Londo.

achievements.name: Seath
achievements.detail: Break the crystal that keeps Seath immortal, then defeat him in the Archives.

achievements.name: To Link the Fire
achievements.detail: Win the last battle in the kiln and finish the journey.
